exposure.needed: whether the environment's Karpenter scheduling ever hit the intermittent nodepool-readiness flake (intermittent runtime behavior, not visible in any static configuration)

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes an intermittent scheduling flake caused by nodepool readiness handling (PR #6491), changing scheduling behavior with no configuration change on the operator side.

decision.reason: The linked PR says the flake came from a NodePool that "did not set the group", so the readiness controller did not reconcile it again [ev-f0215a9bf24c]. The PR and commit change only test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go [ev-b889081063a3] [ev-28bbf8a48e60], meaning this fixes the upstream e2e test suite, not shipped product behaviour. No customer environment is exposed, so the proposed undecidable runtime-behaviour condition is wrong and no correct product assertion follows from the evidence.
